integrity: Self-contained group-law counting proof with standalone finite-field cross-check; not an independent mathematical audit.
scientific_limitations: Counts all ordered homomorphisms in characteristic two, not image/conjugacy classes. Limit fixes field size and domain rank; priority relative to general subgroup-counting formulas not independently established.
title: Rank-stratified elementary \(2\)-group homomorphisms into even-characteristic Heisenberg groups
